title: Routed logical SSM experts from one state-transition basis
hypothesis: A small per-expert orthogonal state-view code can produce multiple routed recurrent functions from one shared stable SSM while reducing actual payload bytes versus storing complete SSM experts.
physical_object: One fixed stable 8-state linear SSM transition/readout basis with a scalar input-selective gate; 8 routed expert roles share all physical weights.
mirror_coordinate: Four Givens angles per expert form Q_e; only the transition is viewed as A_e=Q_e^T A Q_e. B and C remain physically shared and unchanged so each route defines a distinct input-output recurrence. The exact native control materializes this same A_e.
logical_multiplicity: Eight logical recurrent experts process role-routed sequences; router IDs are explicit and charged in every payload.

task.dynamics: u_t=sigmoid(w_g*x_t+b_g)*x_t; h_t=A_e h_(t-1)+B*u_t; y_t=C^T h_t. A_e=Q_e^T A Q_e; B and C are identical across experts. Base A has spectral norm 0.65; Q_e is block-diagonal with four independently coded Givens angles.
task.data: One per-seed deterministic standard-normal input batch with sparse signed impulses is broadcast identically across all eight experts. This makes cross-expert output diversity compare functions on the same inputs.
task.scope: Fixed synthetic linear selective-SSM mechanism only; no parameter learning and no language-model or trained Mamba claim.

controls: one unconditioned shared SSM for all routes
native generated-weight control that materializes A_e from the shared transition matrix and same angle codes, retaining shared B/C; algebraically identical to the transition view
independent full per-expert SSM parameter copies

development.selection_metric: output NRMSE to FP32 reference, actual compressed payload bytes including route IDs, expert output diversity, and steady-state tokens/s
development.runtime_protocol: Deserialize/materialize once; warm up five batches; time ten repeats on one CPU thread.

amendment.reason: Initial implementation broadcast different input sequences by expert, invalidating the diversity metric, and transformed A/B/C together, which is a pure state-coordinate gauge change that preserves each input-output function.
amendment.change: Use identical inputs across experts and view transition A only while keeping B/C shared. Preserve the initial invalid run under runs/initial_invalid_similarity_gauge/; rerun only the same development seeds. No fresh seed was accessed and no threshold or optimizer setting changed.

storage.format: compressed NPZ, FP16 weights/codes and uint8 route IDs
paid_objects: all shared or per-expert SSM weights
four view angles per expert or full expert copies

compute.include: Zero training updates; report processed recurrent tokens, per-token arithmetic proxy, one-time weight materialization, and steady-state CPU tokens/s.

success_gate: Both seeds: Mirror serialized output NRMSE <=0.01, payload <=0.80x independent expert bank, throughput >=0.80x native generated-weight control, output diversity RMS >=0.05, and no exact native alias without incremental benefit. Passing only qualifies for fresh confirmation.
failure_gate: FAIL if any seed misses quality, byte, runtime or diversity thresholds, or if native weight generation reproduces the Mirror payload and outputs with no incremental Mirror-specific value.
boundaries: This is not a trained S4/Mamba model or natural-language benchmark.
The teacher transition bank is deliberately generated from Givens views of A with shared B/C; results do not establish arbitrary expert capacity.
The initial unamended diversity result is invalid and is excluded from terminal claims; its artifacts are retained for provenance.
A native generated-weight alias is explicitly tested and blocks a Mirror-specific claim.
Fresh worlds remain sealed unless both development seeds pass all gates.
